A.name: Recycling
rules: Accept only clearly recyclable items. Every accepted item must be visibly clean, dry, and empty.
Accept clean, dry, uncoated ordinary paper or cardboard without food or grease residue.
Accept empty, visibly clean metal food or beverage cans.
Accept empty, visibly clean glass bottles or jars, intact and without non-glass contents.
Accept empty, visibly clean rigid plastic food/drink bottles or containers only when a visible resin code identifies PET (#1) or HDPE (#2).
A recycling symbol alone does not establish acceptance. Do not infer invisible resin codes, cleanliness, or coatings. Visible food or liquid residue disqualifies an item.

B.name: Trash
rules: Accept items not clearly accepted by bin A. When recyclability, material, cleanliness, or acceptance cannot be established, choose this bin.
Include dirty, greasy, or wet items, food, tissues, paper towels, coated or lined cups, plastic bags, films, wrappers, foam, ceramics, mirrors, and mixed-material packaging.
Do not assume an unreadable or hidden plastic code is #1 or #2.

hold_rules: Hold hazardous objects for inspection rather than pushing them: batteries, electronics, chemicals, sharp broken glass, or chemical containers.
